clips.send: Georgia. Native peoples lived here for 13,000 years before the colony was named for King George II in 1732. Today Georgia is the largest state east of the Mississippi River by land area, with 159 counties.

clips.send: The first transcontinental railroad. Golden spike: 10 May 1869. Union Pacific built west from Omaha; Central Pacific built east from Sacramento. They met at Promontory Summit, Utah. The Central Pacific hired thousands of Chinese workers (华工 huágōng) — at the peak most of its workforce. They blasted tunnels through the granite of the Sierra Nevada. A coast-to-coast trip shrank from months to about a week.

clips.send: Ellis Island. From 1892 to 1954 about 12 million immigrants entered the USA through the station on this island in New York Harbor.

clips.send: 佐治亚。早在1732年这里以英王乔治二世的名字命名之前，美洲原住民已经在这片土地上生活了一万三千年。今天，佐治亚是密西西比河以东陆地面积最大的州，共有159个县。

clips.send: 第一条横贯大陆铁路。1869年5月10日钉下“金道钉”。联合太平洋铁路从奥马哈向西修，中央太平洋铁路从萨克拉门托向东修，两路在犹他州海角点（Promontory Summit）会合。。中央太平洋铁路雇用了成千上万名华工，高峰时占其工人的大多数。他们在内华达山脉的花岗岩中开凿隧道。。横穿大陆的时间从几个月缩短到大约一周。
